name: High Visibility Espresso Cup

icon.alt: small white and red checkered cup on a shelf

description: Inspired by the red and white checkered pattern of those small buildings I see at every airport, this cup is hand painted with the same pattern to be easily spotted in a crowded workplace – signaling good things to come.
